name: simulate_cost
description: Estimate credit cost before running one credit-consuming tool. Pass `tool` + same `arguments` you would pass to that tool. Read-only — never charges.

tool.description: Target tool to price. Use the real tool name, not legacy simulate_* names.

arguments.description: Same args as target tool. Omit or pass {} to get required/optional args for targets that need input. If unsure, reload tools/list and inspect the target tool schema.
